description: This file implements Weave-specific integration for OpenTelemetry observability in a machine learning context. It defines classes and functions to set attributes on OTEL spans, configure OTEL endpoints and headers, and provide a logger for Litellm that sends trace data to Weave/W&B. It includes environment variable handling, span attribute setting, and override logic for span creation and metric emission tailored for Weave's telemetry system.

classes.name: WeaveLLMObsOTELAttributes
classes.description: Class extending BaseLLMObsOTELAttributes, implementing Weave-specific logic to set span attributes related to messages and open inference conventions.

classes.name: WeaveOtelLogger
classes.description: Custom OpenTelemetry logger for Weave/W&B integration, tasked with creating spans, setting attributes, and managing OTEL communication for Weave tracing.

methods.name: set_messages(span: "Span", kwargs: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Static method that sets message attributes on a span in OpenInference format, extracting messages and optional parameters from kwargs.

methods.name: _set_weave_specific_attributes(span: Span, kwargs: dict[str, Any], response_obj: Any)
methods.description: Sets Weave-specific OTEL span attributes such as display name, thread ID, and response output, based on metadata and response_obj.

methods.name: str _get_weave_authorization_header(api_key: str)
methods.description: Generates a Basic authentication header for Weave OTEL using the provided API key.

methods.name: WeaveOtelConfig get_weave_otel_config()
methods.description: Fetches and constructs the Weave OTEL configuration object based on environment variables, including endpoint, headers, and auth.

methods.name: set_weave_otel_attributes(span: Span, kwargs: dict[str, Any], response_obj: Any)
methods.description: Delegates setting of generic OTEL attributes and Weave-specific attributes on a span, using utility functions and class methods.

methods.name: __init__( self, config: Optional[OpenTelemetryConfig] = None, callback_name: Optional[str] = "weave_otel", **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes an instance of WeaveOtelLogger, configuring OTEL exporter and endpoint from environment variables if not provided.

methods.name: _maybe_log_raw_request(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, parent_span)
methods.description: Override to skip creating a separate span for raw request; for Weave, only a single span is used.

methods.name: _start_primary_span( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, context, parent_span=None, )
methods.description: Creates and starts a new span for the LLM call, always as a child of the current context, overriding default behavior to ensure proper nesting.

methods.name: _handle_success(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles the completion of the request, creating spans and avoiding ending of externally provided parent spans.

methods.name: dict|None construct_dynamic_otel_headers( self, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams )
methods.description: Builds dynamic OTEL headers including authorization and project ID from supplied callback parameters.
